The report found that ocean heat content has increased significantly since 2018, contributing to faster sea-level rise and melting ice in the Arctic Ocean.  The report calls for urgent action to protect marine ecosystems, reduce plastic pollution, and regulate deep-sea mining. **United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres** urged a new relationship with the ocean based on science, international law, and shared responsibility.

recent_articles.title: Israel kills 14 in southern Lebanon after trading fire with Iran | Israel attacks Lebanon News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Israel** killed at least 14 people and wounded dozens in air strikes across southern Lebanon after **Iran** warned of “crushing measures” if Israel continued its assault. The escalation followed an Israeli attack on Beirut and a series of clashes between **Hezbollah**, the Lebanese armed group, and **Israeli** forces.  The violence has resulted in a humanitarian crisis with over one million people displaced and the IRC warning that Lebanon's needs are massive.

recent_articles.title: Trump booed at Knicks-Spurs game as he became first US president at NBA Finals
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump**, the first sitting US president to attend the NBA Finals, was booed by frustrated ticketholders at Madison Square Garden in New York City. **Trump** attended game three of the best-of-seven series between the **New York Knicks** and the **San Antonio Spurs** with his granddaughter Kai Trump, **James Dolan**, owner of the **Knicks**, and members of his administration. The president's visit led to extensive security measures that disrupted celebrations and caused traffic disruptions in the area. Celebrities including **Timothee Chalamet**, **Tina Fey**, and **Larry David** were also present at the game.

recent_articles.title: Dalit teen beaten to death in Tehri Garhwal over inter-caste friendship - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: An 18-year-old Dalit youth, **Ketan Lal**, was fatally beaten and his friend severely injured in Uttarakhand, India. The incident occurred after **Ketan**'s friendship with a girl from an upper caste community sparked conflict.  The girl's family allegedly assaulted **Ketan** and his friend, locking them in a room before the incident. **Ketan** died at a local hospital, prompting outrage and demands for action against the assailants. The police have filed a murder case and detained one suspect.

recent_articles.title: Israel-Iran Strikes Resume: 3 Major Takeaways From Latest Escalation
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Iran** and **Israel** resumed direct strikes on each other's territories after a ceasefire agreement, escalating tensions in the region.  **Donald Trump**, US President, called for an immediate ceasefire and stated that "final negotiations" were proceeding. The attacks followed **Iran**'s assertion that it would not engage in peace talks with the US until **Israel** ceased its actions in Lebanon. This escalation complicates efforts to achieve a ceasefire in Lebanon, while also raising concerns about the future of US-brokered peace negotiations and regional stability.  The events highlight the challenges facing both **Trump** and **Netanyahu**, who are facing elections later this year.

recent_articles.title: Naga man killed by armed miscreants in Kangpokpi forest | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **Rongmei Naga** man, 58-year-old Chungjanglung Panmei, was killed by armed miscreants in Kangpokpi district of Manipur while collecting firewood. The incident occurred around 6:40 am on Monday when a group of villagers from Pongringlong Part-I were attacked. **Pongringlong Youth Club**, a local Rongmei Naga body, and the **village authority** stated that Panmei was killed by Kuki militants in Kangpokpi forests.  The police launched a rescue operation and recovered his body with four bullet injury marks.

recent_articles.title: Bhagwant Singh surplus land case: Ambala officer cancels mutation of 810 acres | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sanjeev Verma**, **Ambala Divisional Commissioner**, has ordered the cancellation of land mutations in seven Panchkula villages, totaling over 810 acres. The land, valued at Rs 5,000 crore, belonged to **Sardar Bhagwant Singh**, an erstwhile king, and is now being transferred to the state government. This decision follows years of legal proceedings regarding the ownership of the estate, which has been disputed for decades.

recent_articles.title: ‘Confident of high growth in Q1 despite elevated energy prices’ | Business News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite elevated energy prices due to the war in West Asia, **the Indian government** is confident that the economy continues to perform well.  The high growth seen in January-March has spilled over into the new fiscal year, with data showing strong industrial growth and increased GST collections from imports. The government is taking steps to attract foreign capital, including tax cuts for foreign institutional investors (FIIs) investments in government bonds, aiming to boost India's inclusion in the Bloomberg Global Aggregate Bond Index.  The **Reserve Bank of India** has lowered its GDP growth forecast for 2026-27 but acknowledges the government's efforts to mitigate pressures on the economy.

recent_articles.title: Mamata Banerjee, TMC: How one of India's most successful female politicians is losing her party
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Trinamool Congress (TMC), led by Mamata Banerjee, is experiencing a significant internal crisis following its loss in the recent West Bengal elections.  Banerjee's party has faced a rebellion from many of its legislators and MPs, who have accused her and her nephew of corruption and forging signatures on legislative documents. This has resulted in several TMC members seeking to align with the BJP-led ruling alliance. Political analysts suggest that this is part of a broader trend of regional parties becoming more centralized and family-centric, making them vulnerable after losing power. Banerjee remains defiant, but the future of the party remains uncertain.

recent_articles.title: SpaceX's stock market blast-off could be Musk's biggest gamble yet
recent_articles.rephrased_article: SpaceX, led by Elon Musk, is launching its initial public offering (IPO) of shares. The company's valuation has soared to $1.75 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies on Earth.  Musk's ambitious vision for space exploration and artificial intelligence, including plans for a multiplanetary future and data centers in space, fuels investor interest. However, concerns remain about the control Musk will exert over the company and potential risks associated with investing in this rapidly evolving sector.

recent_articles.title: Nuclear Arms Spending Hits Record High, China Leads Global Expansion
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Worldwide** spending on nuclear weapons reached a record high of nearly $119 billion in 2025, according to the **International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons (ICAN)**. The nine nuclear-armed states collectively increased their investments by 19% from 2024, with the **United States** leading the spending at over $69.2 billion.  The **Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI)** also reported that the number of nuclear warheads available for potential use has risen despite a decline in the overall number of weapons. This trend is attributed to geopolitical tensions and competition between great powers with nuclear arms, prompting concerns about an escalating nuclear risk.
